about:
RSP Supply operates from North Salt Lake, Utah, as a supplier of industrial automation and electrical components. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The firm stocks a broad catalog of products from manufacturers such as ABB, Eaton, Phoenix Contact, and Schneider Electric, covering categories that include enclosures, circuit protection, motors and drives, power supplies, connectors, and instrumentation. In addition to distribution, RSP Supply runs a custom fabrication shop that builds control panels to customer specifications and modifies enclosures with cutouts, mounting hardware, and accessories. The company also provides engineering support for industrial automation systems and procurement services for hard-to-find parts.

Customers span the energy storage, power measurement, and industrial automation sectors, with specific demand for energy storage connectors, power and energy meters, and current transformers. The supplier serves original equipment manufacturers, panel builders, and maintenance teams that require both off-the-shelf components and tailored fabrication.

RSP Supply differentiates itself with free U.S. ground parcel shipping on every order, a low small-order fee, and a service model that combines distribution with in-house fabrication and engineering support to reduce lead times on customized assemblies.
